description: This is a Java test class for ContentService related to static content files and images in the Shopizer project. It includes test methods for creating, retrieving, and removing static files and images, mainly for testing static content file handling.

classes.name: StaticContentTestCase
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing static content handling (images and files) within the SalesManager core project.

methods.name: createImage
methods.description: Creates an image content file, uploads it via ContentService, retrieves it, saves it locally, and then removes it.

methods.name: testCreateStaticContent
methods.description: Uploads a static ZIP file as content, testing handling of static files.

methods.name: testCreateMultipleStaticContent
methods.description: Uploads multiple static files (ZIP and DOC), testing batch upload functionality.
